facts.text: Through the LIU Promise program, undergraduate students are paired with a dedicated success coach starting in their first semester to provide personal academic advising, career coaching, and support through graduation.

sources.title: Career Success | Long Island University
sources.quote: You will participate in career success workshops, create your resume during your first semester, and participate in job and internship fairs. LIU Promise offers several resources to guide you throughout your career journey

sources.title: Career Success | Long Island University
sources.quote: Your success coach is your own experienced and trained career coach that will support you every step of the way.
